summary: Verified MySQL legacy -> MongoDB migration into tenant 'albero-della-vita'. Backend: 12/12 tests pass (all counts match spec: 226 students, 197 parents pending, 13 staff [6 admin + 7 teachers], 6 classrooms, 87 unassigned, 77 lesson plans, 25 events, 5 communications, 19 meals, 7 extra labs). Multi-tenancy isolation confirmed (demo admin does NOT see Albero data). Teacher role restrictions confirmed (/s/tenant redirects away). Frontend: dashboard, alunni, sezioni, maestre, genitori, comunicazioni, eventi, tesserini all render correctly. Found 2 DATA migration bugs (not code bugs, per request scope): (1) lesson_plans missing school_year_id -> UI /s/piano shows 'Nessun piano didattico' hiding all 77 plans; (2) menus use date_from/date_to instead of valid_from/valid_to -> UI /s/menu-mensa shows empty 'Dal al' date range and /api/menus/current will never return the migrated menu.

minor.issue: Returns 0 when school_year_id filter applied (as frontend does by default) because migrated lesson_plans have NO school_year_id field. Backend is correct; migration script forgot to set it.
Migrated menus store date_from/date_to but server endpoints POST/current use valid_from/valid_to. UI shows empty date range on menu card. /api/menus/current will never match.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Attività di oggi' displays truncated student_id (e.g. 'b13923c8…') instead of student full name. Code at /app/frontend/src/pages/staff/Dashboard.jsx:168 hard-codes a.student_id.slice(0,8). Pre-existing issue, surfaced now with 1405 migrated activities.
Defaults to first classroom tab (Fiorellini Rossi) instead of 'Tutte'. User must click 'Tutte' manually. Combined with missing school_year_id, all 77 plans currently invisible.

integration_issues.issue: Shows 'Nessun piano didattico' for every classroom tab AND 'Tutte' because frontend sends school_year_id in query and migrated lesson_plans lack this field. 77 plans hidden.
Menu card renders 'Dal  al ' with empty dates because the menu document only has date_from/date_to, not valid_from/valid_to that the UI expects.

issues: Date rendered as '13/11/2024 00:00' — the trailing '00:00' is noise; should be DD/MM/YYYY only for all-day comms

critical_code_review_comments: mysql_migrate.py writes menu dates as date_from/date_to but backend GET /menus/current and the UI expect valid_from/valid_to. Field-name drift between migration and schema -> silent data corruption. Suggest a Pydantic model MenuIn re-used by migration script.

lesson_plans, communications, calendar_events creation endpoints default school_year_id to active year; migration bypassed this logic and skipped the field entirely. Any school_year scoped query will return 0 for migrated rows.

Dashboard.jsx displays raw truncated student_id instead of denormalized student name — this would be ugly for any tenant, not just migrated data. Recommend $lookup join or client-side map by student_id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_migration.py is green against current migrated data. Two confirmed data migration gaps: (1) lesson_plans.school_year_id missing -> frontend /s/piano empty; (2) menus use date_from/date_to not valid_from/valid_to -> empty date range in UI and /api/menus/current broken. After main agent runs the two mongo updateMany statements above, re-run the test suite plus manually visit /s/piano (should show 77 plans) and /s/menu-mensa (should show '02/09/2026 — 31/07/2027' range).
rca of the issue: Root cause: mysql_migrate.py inserted documents using legacy MySQL column names (date_from/date_to for menus) without translating to the Mongo schema expected by server.py (valid_from/valid_to). It also omitted the school_year_id FK on lesson_plans/communications/calendar_events because the legacy MySQL table didn't have it; the migration should have resolved the active school year once at startup and stamped it on every imported temporal row. Reproduction: login as filippo.malafronte@gmail.com, open /s/piano -> 'Nessun piano didattico' on every tab incl. 'Tutte'; open /s/menu-mensa -> card header 'Dal  al '. Mitigation: two targeted mongo updateMany statements (above) + patch mysql_migrate.py so re-runs stay idempotent correctly.
